description: Synthetic feedback scenarios on audited real restaurants. Labels/IDs only, no runtime user records or source menu/review text. Seeds overlap restaurant identities and are not independent users. Development scenarios have already been used for model comparison; they are not an untouched test set.

label_protocol.cutlet: Both target styles share raw cat2 Japanese/cat3 cutlet. Style labels audited from full collected menus/reviews before model evaluation; mixed-style shops excluded.
label_protocol.noodle: Primary hot soup noodles: ramen versus Korean noodles. Held-out panel is small and incomplete; inspect actual full-catalogue top restaurants before judging food correctness.
label_protocol.priors: Target-food-free prior stores; none/like/dislike inversion share exactly the same current feedback and held-out targets. Soft priors use 15/20 versus5/20 likes, not all-or-nothing.
label_protocol.switch: A cutlet -> B noodles -> A cutlet,8responses perphase, latest rating replaces prior rating for same store. Never-trained target restaurants stay excluded from all observations.
